title: Early Stopping in Large Reasoning Models: A Survey and Empirical Audit of Efficiency and Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2611.00166v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large reasoning models can improve accuracy by generating longer reasoning traces, but some of this computation may be unnecessary. Early-stopping methods aim to stop once enough reasoning is available to answer. Evaluating these methods requires accounting for the cost of deciding when to stop and the reliability of the resulting answer. We evaluate different methods across five reasoning models on mathematical and scientific reasoning, code generation, and factuality tasks by using a shared rollout replay protocol. We introduce Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) to measure efficiency relative to the oracle across accuracy targets. We also examine correctness at later exit positions, transfer across models and tasks, post-stop reasoning continuation, and retained justification quality. In our experiments, correctness can decrease at later positions beyond what the fitted decoding-noise model predicts. Reliability checks also

translated_title: 大型推理模型中的早停机制：效率与可靠性的综述与实证审计
translated_abstract: 大型推理模型可以通过生成更长的推理过程来提高准确率，但其中部分计算可能是不必要的。早停方法旨在一旦拥有足够的推理信息能够作答时即停止。评估这些方法需要同时考虑决定何时停止的成本以及所得答案的可靠性。我们通过共享的rollout重放协议，在数学与科学推理、代码生成和事实性任务上，对五种推理模型上的多种方法进行了评估。我们提出了目标积分Token效率指标，用于在多个准确率目标下相对于oracle参照来衡量效率。我们还考察了后期退出位置的正确性、跨模型与跨任务的迁移能力、停止后的推理延续情况以及所保留论证的质量。在实验中，正确率在后续位置可能出现下降，其幅度超出了拟合的解码噪声模型所预测的范围。可靠性检查也……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出TITE（目标积分Token效率）指标并采用共享rollout重放协议，对大型推理模型中的早停方法在效率与可靠性两方面进行了系统性综述与实证审计，发现后期退出位置的正确率下降幅度超出了拟合解码噪声模型的预测。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Target-Integrated Token Efficiency (TITE) and a shared rollout replay protocol to systematically survey and empirically audit early-stopping methods in large reasoning models, finding that correctness can degrade at later exit positions beyond what a fitted decoding-noise model predicts.
